mapper.sql: FROM residence r JOIN person p ON p.person_id = r.person_id JOIN property_unit pu ON pu.property_unit_id = r.property_unit_id JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id = bu.building_id JOIN community c ON c.community_id = b.community_id LEFT JOIN residence rr ON rr.property_unit_id = r.property_unit_id AND rr.end_date IS NULL AND rr.residence_role = 'RESPONSIBLE' LEFT JOIN person rp ON rp.person_id = rr.person_id LEFT JOIN ownership o ON o.property_unit_id = r.property_unit_id AND o.end_date IS NULL LEFT JOIN person op ON op.person_id = o.person_id

WHERE r.end_date IS NULL AND c.community_id IN #{scopeId} AND 1 = 0 AND c.community_id = #{query.communityId} AND pu.occupancy_status = #{query.occupancyStatus} AND r.residence_role = #{query.residenceRole} AND r.relation_to_responsible = #{query.relationToResponsible} AND (p.full_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR p.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR pu.property_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
mapper.select: SELECT r.residence_id, p.person_id, p.full_name, CASE WHEN p.phone IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(p.phone) <= 7 THEN CONCAT(LEFT(p.phone, 2), '***') ELSE CONCAT(LEFT(p.phone, 3), '****', RIGHT(p.phone, 4)) END AS masked_phone, c.community_id, c.community_name, CONCAT(b.building_no, '号楼') AS building_name, COALESCE(bu.unit_name, CONCAT(bu.unit_no, '单元')) AS unit_name, pu.property_no, CONCAT(c.community_name, ' · ', b.building_no, '号楼 · ', COALESCE(bu.unit_name, CONCAT(bu.unit_no, '单元')), ' · ', pu.property_no) AS full_location, r.residence_role, r.relation_to_responsible, pu.occupancy_status, r.start_date ORDER BY c.community_code, b.building_no, bu.unit_no, pu.property_no, r.residence_role LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT r.residence_id, p.person_id, p.full_name, CASE WHEN p.phone IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(p.phone) <= 7 THEN CONCAT(LEFT(p.phone, 2), '***') ELSE CONCAT(LEFT(p.phone, 3), '****', RIGHT(p.phone, 4)) END AS masked_phone, c.community_name, CONCAT(b.building_no, '号楼') AS building_name, COALESCE(bu.unit_name, CONCAT(bu.unit_no, '单元')) AS unit_name, pu.property_no, CONCAT(c.community_name, ' · ', b.building_no, '号楼 · ', COALESCE(bu.unit_name, CONCAT(bu.unit_no, '单元')), ' · ', pu.property_no) AS full_location, r.residence_role, r.relation_to_responsible, rp.full_name AS responsible_name, op.full_name AS owner_name, pu.occupancy_status, r.start_date WHERE r.residence_id = #{residenceId} AND r.end_date IS NULL

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM residence r JOIN property_unit pu ON pu.property_unit_id = r.property_unit_id JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id = bu.building_id WHERE r.end_date IS NULL ) AS active_resident_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM residence r JOIN property_unit pu ON pu.property_unit_id = r.property_unit_id JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id = bu.building_id WHERE r.end_date IS NULL AND r.residence_role = 'RESPONSIBLE' ) AS responsible_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM property_unit pu JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id = bu.building_id WHERE pu.occupancy_status = 'OWNER_OCCUPIED' ) AS owner_occupied_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM property_unit pu JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id = bu.building_id WHERE pu.occupancy_status = 'TENANT_OCCUPIED' ) AS tenant_occupied_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM property_unit pu JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id = bu.building_id WHERE pu.occupancy_status = 'AVAILABLE_FOR_RENT' ) AS available_for_rent_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM property_unit pu JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id = bu.building_id WHERE pu.occupancy_status = 'VACANT' ) AS vacant_count
